title: OpenCodeReasoning: Advancing Data Distillation for Competitive Coding
authors_zh: Wasi Uddin Ahmad、Sean Narenthiran、Somshubra Majumdar、Aleksander Ficek、Siddhartha Jain、Jocelyn Huang、Vahid Noroozi、Boris Ginsburg
paper_type_zh: 竞赛编程推理数据发布、蒸馏配方与执行过滤消融
best_for_zh: 构建代码推理 SFT 数据、研究教师蒸馏与执行筛选，或审计开放数据版本、许可和污染控制的读者
one_line: OpenCodeReasoning releases DeepSeek-R1 competitive-programming traces for Qwen2.5 SFT and shows a diversity-versus-execution-filtering trade-off, but the main rows are not functionally certified and the current recipe has moved toward OCR-2.
OpenCodeReasoning 将 DeepSeek-R1 的竞赛编程推理与 Python 解答蒸馏为 Qwen2.5 的 SFT 数据，并揭示多样性与执行过滤的取舍；但主发布集只通过格式和语法检查，当前官方配方也已转向 OCR-2。
why: It makes a large code-reasoning distillation pipeline inspectable and provides a concrete negative result about execution-only selection, while exposing why row-level verification, rights, decontamination logs, and revision pinning remain necessary.
inclusion_reason: A large open competitive-programming reasoning release that exposes question sourcing, teacher generation, format/syntax filtering, contamination screening, SFT scaling, and an execution-filtering failure case for the Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Published at COLM 2025, OpenCodeReasoning asks how far supervised distillation can scale competitive-programming reasoning when human-written solution traces are scarce and existing open reasoning collections are smaller or incompletely documented. Its Atlas relevance is the construction and release contract: public programming questions are deduplicated, expanded with DeepSeek-R1 reasoning-and-code responses, filtered, released with source metadata, and used for SFT.

A training record is a competitive-programming prompt (or an index that reconstructs it from a source dataset), a DeepSeek-R1 response containing a reasoning trace and final Python code block, extracted solution code, and source/split/license/difficulty identifiers. The paper reports 736,712 Python records over 28,904 questions; the Hugging Face 1.0 card instead reports 735,255 records over 28,319 questions, so revision identity is part of the data object.

The work does not introduce a new functional verifier, prove that every released answer is correct, or study RL training. It reaches L4 because the full paper and appendix, COLM/OpenReview record, dataset, models, and recipe are public and auditable, while exact OCR-1 release lineage, rejected generations, per-row execution labels, and unified source rights remain incomplete.

OpenCodeReasoning 发表于 COLM 2025，研究在人写解题轨迹稀缺、已有开放推理集合规模较小或文档不完整时，竞赛编程推理的监督蒸馏可以扩展到什么程度。它对 Atlas 的价值在于构造与发布契约：对公开编程问题去重，用 DeepSeek-R1 扩展出推理与代码响应，完成筛选后连同来源元数据发布并用于 SFT。

一条训练记录包含竞赛编程 prompt（或可从源数据集重建它的索引）、带推理轨迹和最终 Python 代码块的 DeepSeek-R1 响应、提取后的解答代码，以及来源、split、许可和难度标识。论文报告 736,712 条 Python 记录、覆盖 28,904 个问题；Hugging Face 1.0 数据卡则报告 735,255 条记录、覆盖 28,319 个问题，因此版本身份本身就是数据对象的一部分。

该工作没有提出新的功能正确性 verifier，没有证明每条发布答案都正确，也没有研究 RL 训练。由于全文与附录、COLM/OpenReview 记录、数据集、模型和配方均已公开且可审计，它达到 L4；但 OCR-1 的精确发布 lineage、被拒绝生成、逐行执行标签和统一来源权利仍不完整。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central recipe is to trade a small set of correctness-certified solutions for broad instruction coverage: exact-match-deduplicate public competitive-programming questions, sample many DeepSeek-R1 reasoning-and-code responses, retain format- and syntax-conforming outputs, and measure how corpus scale and execution-based selection change downstream SFT.

| Contract element | What is retained or observed | |---|---| | Prompt | Question text from TACO, APPS, CodeContests, or OpenR1 CodeForces, or a source index for reconstruction | | Teacher behavior | DeepSeek-R1 output, including a tagged reasoning trace and a final code block | | Artifact | Extracted Python solution; C++ is generated for an ablation | | Metadata | id, dataset, split, source, license, difficulty, and when needed index | | Main acceptance signal | Reasoning/code format and syntactic parseability | | Signals not attached release-wide | Unit-test outcome, scalar reward, step label, or calibrated probability of correctness |

Benchmark-overlap screening adds a different feedback layer: cosine retrieval flags pairs, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct judge semantic similarity, and humans inspect the remaining candidates. Unit tests appear only in the CodeContests ablation and benchmark evaluation. The target is therefore answer-level supervision even though the answer includes a long trace.

The closest comparison named in the paper is KODCODE, which contains 447K DeepSeek-R1 code-reasoning samples but fine-tunes on smaller LLM-test-validated subsets. OpenCodeReasoning changes the scale, source mixture, and ablation surface rather than inventing the teacher, SFT objective, syntax parser, or a new verifier.

核心配方是用广泛的问题覆盖替代规模较小的“正确性认证解答集”：对公开竞赛编程问题做精确匹配去重，从 DeepSeek-R1 采样大量推理与代码响应，保留格式和语法合格的输出，再测量语料规模与基于执行的选择如何改变下游 SFT。

| 契约要素 | 保留或可观测内容 | |---|---| | Prompt | 来自 TACO、APPS、CodeContests 或 OpenR1 CodeForces 的问题文本，或用于重建问题的来源索引 | | 教师行为 | DeepSeek-R1 的 output，其中含带标签的推理轨迹和最终代码块 | | 产物 | 提取后的 Python solution；C++ 用于消融实验 | | 元数据 | id、dataset、split、source、license、difficulty，以及必要时的 index | | 主接收信号 | 推理/代码格式与语法可解析性 | | 未覆盖整个发布集的信号 | 单元测试结果、标量 reward、步骤标签或校准后的正确概率 |

benchmark 重叠筛查提供另一层反馈：余弦检索先标出候选对，Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 判断语义相似度，再由人工检查剩余候选。单元测试只用于 CodeContests 消融和 benchmark 评测。因此，尽管答案含长轨迹，监督粒度仍是 answer-level。

论文列出的最近比较对象是 KODCODE：它含 447K 条 DeepSeek-R1 代码推理样本，但只在经过 LLM 测试验证的较小子集上微调。OpenCodeReasoning 改变的是规模、来源混合和消融界面，而不是发明教师、SFT 目标、语法解析器或新的 verifier。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper's reconstructable pipeline is:

  1. Inputs. Collect TACO, APPS, CodeContests, and OpenR1 CodeForces questions, remove exact string duplicates, and retain 28,904 questions. Exclude the CodeContests and OpenR1 CodeForces test splits in the public release.
  2. Contamination screen. Retrieve each question's nearest evaluation neighbor at cosine similarity threshold 0.7 for LiveCodeBench, CodeContests, HumanEval, and MBPP. Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct judge the flagged pairs; manual inspection of 90 pairs (at most 0.3% of the question set) finds no paraphrase or semantic match.
  3. Generation. DeepSeek-R1 produces multiple solutions per question through SGLang, primarily in Python, using nucleus sampling with temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, an injected reasoning-start tag, and maximum output length 16k. A parallel C++ branch supports an IOI ablation.
  4. Selection. Require a completed reasoning trace and final python or cpp code block, reject code blocks inside the reasoning trace, extract the final solution, and parse syntax with Tree-sitter. The main path does not execute every solution.
  5. Outputs. The paper obtains 736,712 Python and 355,792 C++ samples. The HF 1.0 release exposes input, output, extracted solution, and provenance fields; split_1 reconstructs APPS/TACO prompts through dataset, split, and index.
  6. Training/evaluation. Fine-tune Qwen2.5 base and instruct 7B, 14B, and 32B models for 3 epochs with AdamW, batch 256, maximum sequence 32,768, learning rate 5e-5, cosine decay, warmup ratio 0.1, BF16, packing, and tensor/context parallelism on H100-80GB GPUs. Evaluation uses temperature 0.6 and maximum generation 30,720.

Reproduction must pin two recipes. The paper's OCR-1 generation uses 16k output, while current NVIDIA-NeMo/Skills commit 74b8649 recommends OCR-2, prepares about 34K questions, truncates prompts above 3,200 tokens, and sets 32 random seeds plus 28,768 generated tokens in r1.yaml. That current code is a useful scaffold, not a frozen manifest of the paper's original run.

论文中可重建的流水线如下：

  1. 输入。 收集 TACO、APPS、CodeContests 和 OpenR1 CodeForces 问题，删除精确字符串重复项，保留 28,904 个问题；公开发布时排除 CodeContests 与 OpenR1 CodeForces 的 test split。
  2. 污染筛查。 针对 LiveCodeBench、CodeContests、HumanEval 和 MBPP，以余弦相似度阈值 0.7 检索每个问题最近的评测邻居。Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 判断候选对，再人工检查 90 对（至多占问题集的 0.3%），没有发现释义或语义匹配。
  3. 生成。 DeepSeek-R1 通过 SGLang 为每个问题生成多个解答，以 Python 为主；使用 nucleus sampling、温度 0.6、top-p 0.95、注入的推理起始标签和 16k 最大输出长度。并行的 C++ 分支用于 IOI 消融。
  4. 选择。 要求完整推理轨迹和最终 python 或 cpp 代码块，拒绝推理轨迹内部含代码块的响应，提取最终解答，并用 Tree-sitter 解析语法。主路径不会执行每条解答。
  5. 输出。 论文得到 736,712 条 Python 和 355,792 条 C++ 样本。HF 1.0 发布集暴露 input、output、提取后的 solution 与 provenance 字段；split_1 通过 dataset、split 和 index 重建 APPS/TACO prompt。
  6. 训练与评测。 对 Qwen2.5 base 和 instruct 的 7B、14B、32B 模型执行 3 个 epoch 的微调，使用 AdamW、batch 256、最大序列 32,768、学习率 5e-5、cosine 衰减、warmup ratio 0.1、BF16、packing 和 tensor/context parallelism，硬件为 H100-80GB GPU。评测使用温度 0.6 和最大生成长度 30,720。

复现必须固定两套配方。论文 OCR-1 生成使用 16k 输出；当前 NVIDIA-NeMo/Skills 提交 74b8649 推荐 OCR-2，准备约 34K 个问题，截断超过 3,200 token 的 prompt，并在 r1.yaml 中设置 32 个随机种子与 28,768 个生成 token。当前代码是有用的 scaffold，但不是论文原始运行的冻结 manifest。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The main evaluation uses LiveCodeBench 2408-2502 (279 problems) and CodeContests. The paper reports average pass@1 over 64 LiveCodeBench generations and 16 CodeContests generations, while Table 2 says baseline rows were run once. After 3-epoch SFT on the full Python corpus, OCR-Qwen-32B reaches 61.8 on LiveCodeBench and 24.6 on CodeContests, compared with R1-Distill-Qwen-32B at 58.1/18.3, QwQ-32B at 61.3/20.2, and DeepSeek-R1 at 65.6/26.2. OCR-Qwen-7B-Instruct reaches 51.3/18.1. These are model outcomes under the paper's evaluation protocol, not direct measurements of row correctness.

The scaling curve expands from 25k to 100k and finally 736k samples; the authors report that it has not plateaued and attribute the largest final gains to adding unique, varied, difficult questions. The paper does not isolate unique-question count from total response count in a complete factorial design.

The execution-filtering ablation provides the most important negative result:

| Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct training subset | Rows | LiveCodeBench | CodeContests | |---|---:|---:|---:| | All CodeContests-derived rows | 445,618 | 54.1 | 16.59 | | Unit-test-passing rows | 151,251 | 47.0 | 15.34 | | Equal-sized all-failing rows | 151,251 | 52.3 | 15.53 |

The authors link the result to harder questions being overrepresented among failures and argue for instruction diversity. The defensible conclusion is narrower: in this selection setup, correctness-only filtering removes useful coverage. It does not show that incorrect reasoning is intrinsically better training data.

For OCR-Qwen-32B-Instruct, adding 356K C++ samples changes LiveCodeBench/CodeContests/IOI from 61.7/24.4/145.5 to 61.5/25.5/175.5, supporting language-specific IOI transfer without consistent Python-benchmark gain. Finally, the paper's 736,712-row total differs from the HF 1.0 card's 735,255; this release discrepancy is evidence for pinning, not evidence about data quality.

主要评测使用 LiveCodeBench 2408-2502（279 个问题）和 CodeContests。论文报告 LiveCodeBench 的平均 pass@1 基于 64 次生成，CodeContests 基于 16 次生成，而表 2 说明 baseline 行只运行一次。在完整 Python 语料上做 3 个 epoch 的 SFT 后，OCR-Qwen-32B 在 LiveCodeBench 和 CodeContests 上达到 61.8 与 24.6；R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 为 58.1/18.3，QwQ-32B 为 61.3/20.2，DeepSeek-R1 为 65.6/26.2。OCR-Qwen-7B-Instruct 达到 51.3/18.1。这些是论文评测协议下的模型结果，不是对行级正确性的直接测量。

扩展曲线从 25k 增长到 100k，最终达到 736k 条样本；作者报告曲线尚未饱和，并把最后阶段的最大增益归因于加入独特、多样且困难的问题。论文没有用完整析因设计分离“唯一问题数”和“响应总数”的影响。

执行过滤消融给出最重要的负结果：

| Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 训练子集 | 行数 | LiveCodeBench | CodeContests | |---|---:|---:|---:| | 全部 CodeContests 来源行 | 445,618 | 54.1 | 16.59 | | 通过单元测试的行 | 151,251 | 47.0 | 15.34 | | 等量且全部失败的行 | 151,251 | 52.3 | 15.53 |

作者将这一结果与失败样本中困难问题占比更高联系起来，并主张重视指令多样性。可支持的结论更窄：在该选择设置中，只保留正确解会删除有用的问题覆盖；它不能说明错误推理本质上是更好的训练数据。

对 OCR-Qwen-32B-Instruct，加入 356K 条 C++ 样本后，LiveCodeBench/CodeContests/IOI 从 61.7/24.4/145.5 变为 61.5/25.5/175.5，说明存在语言特定的 IOI 迁移，但 Python benchmark 没有一致增益。最后，论文的 736,712 条总数与 HF 1.0 卡片的 735,255 不同；这一发布差异是固定版本的依据，不是数据质量证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier reasoning-distillation releases discussed in the paper commonly contain 17k-114k question-solution pairs; KODCODE reports 447K DeepSeek-R1 samples but trains on smaller LLM-test-validated subsets. OpenCodeReasoning's concrete change is to combine 736,712 Python responses, 28,904 paper-version questions, explicit source fields, a contamination workflow, staged scaling, and correctness/language ablations in one release-and-training study.

The teacher, nucleus sampling, answer-level SFT, Tree-sitter parsing, public question sources, unit tests, and LLM-as-judge screening are existing components. The work's contribution is their scale and controlled comparison, especially the observation that execution-only filtering changes the problem distribution and can reduce downstream scores. It is not a new verifier, reward model, or process-supervision interface.

For reasoning-data research, the directional value is to treat instruction support, response multiplicity, correctness labels, and training scale as separate variables. Reuse still requires checking whether the released revision preserves the experimental mixture, whether semantic duplicates remain, how many candidates each question received, which failures were dropped, and whether source licenses permit the intended training use.

论文讨论的早期推理蒸馏发布通常含 17k-114k 个问题—解答对；KODCODE 报告 447K 条 DeepSeek-R1 样本，但只在经过 LLM 测试验证的较小子集上训练。OpenCodeReasoning 的具体变化，是在同一项发布与训练研究中结合 736,712 条 Python 响应、论文版本的 28,904 个问题、显式来源字段、污染流程、分阶段扩展，以及正确性和语言消融。

教师、nucleus sampling、answer-level SFT、Tree-sitter 解析、公开问题源、单元测试和 LLM-as-judge 筛查都是已有组件。该工作的贡献是扩大并受控比较这些组件，尤其是观察到“只按执行结果筛选”会改变问题分布，并可能降低下游分数。它不是新的 verifier、reward model 或过程监督接口。

对推理数据研究，其方向性价值是把问题支持集、每题响应数、正确性标签和训练规模视为独立变量。复用前仍要检查：发布版本是否保留实验混合、是否残留语义重复、每题生成了多少候选、哪些失败被丢弃，以及来源许可是否允许预期训练用途。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Functional validity: format checks and Tree-sitter can reject malformed output but cannot detect wrong algorithms, missing edge cases, or persuasive yet invalid reasoning. The release schema does not attach a unit-test result to every row.
  • Selection confounding: the “incorrect” and “correct” 151,251-row subsets cover different difficulty and instruction distributions. The 445,618-row no-filter condition is also larger, so the ablation cannot isolate target correctness as a single causal variable.
  • Version drift: paper totals are 736,712 rows and 28,904 questions; HF 1.0 totals are 735,255 and 28,319. The current OCR-2-oriented recipe uses 32 seeds and 28,768 generated tokens instead of freezing the OCR-1 16k setup.
  • Deduplication and contamination: exact-match deduplication misses semantic duplicates. The 0.7 retrieval screen and two LLM judges can produce false negatives, and the 90 manually reviewed pairs are not accompanied by a public decision manifest.
  • Lineage and failures: original random seeds, rollout count, job/chunk manifests, rejection yields, rejected responses, and per-row execution outcomes are unavailable. split_1 also depends on external APPS/TACO rows reconstructed from indices.
  • Rights: the HF release is labeled CC BY 4.0 but tells users to inspect each underlying dataset license; platform terms and source licenses are not replaced by the aggregate label. Apache-2.0 covers the current code, not automatically the data.
  • Evaluation: OCR rows are averaged over repeated generations while Table 2 says baselines were run once. Results cover competitive programming and do not establish general code correctness, security, maintainability, or cross-domain reasoning quality.
  • Reproducibility: hardware type and training hyperparameters are disclosed, but hardware count, original packing/order manifests, checkpoint hashes, complete compute, and an independent OCR-1 reproduction are not verified.

• 功能有效性：格式检查和 Tree-sitter 可以拒绝畸形输出，但无法发现错误算法、遗漏边界条件或看似可信却无效的推理。发布 schema 没有为每一行附加单元测试结果。
  • 选择混杂：“错误”和“正确”的两个 151,251 行子集覆盖不同的难度和问题分布；不筛选条件还有 445,618 行，规模也更大，因此消融无法把目标正确性隔离为单一因果变量。
  • 版本漂移：论文总数为 736,712 行和 28,904 个问题；HF 1.0 总数为 735,255 和 28,319。当前面向 OCR-2 的配方使用 32 个种子与 28,768 个生成 token，而没有冻结 OCR-1 的 16k 设置。
  • 去重与污染：精确匹配去重会遗漏语义重复。阈值 0.7 的检索筛查和两个 LLM judge 可能产生假阴性，人工检查的 90 对也没有公开决策 manifest。
  • Lineage 与失败：原始随机种子、rollout 数、job/chunk manifest、拒绝率、被拒响应和逐行执行结果均不可用。split_1 还依赖通过索引重建的外部 APPS/TACO 行。
  • 权利：HF 发布集标为 CC BY 4.0，但要求用户检查每个底层数据集许可；聚合标签不会替代平台条款与来源许可。Apache-2.0 覆盖当前代码，并不会自动覆盖数据。
  • 评测：OCR 行基于重复生成取平均，而表 2 说明 baseline 只运行一次。结果覆盖竞赛编程，不能证明一般代码正确性、安全性、可维护性或跨领域推理质量。
  • 可复现性：硬件类型和训练超参数已披露，但硬件数量、原始 packing/order manifest、checkpoint hash、完整 compute 和独立 OCR-1 复现均未核验。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track, this work is a reusable design and audit case rather than merely a model-score report.

  • Conditional training reuse: pin the HF revision, retain every provenance field, resolve per-source licenses, reconstruct split_1 prompts deterministically, and run functional tests plus target-benchmark decontamination before SFT. The release-level CC BY 4.0 label is not sufficient on its own.
  • Filtering baseline: compare format/syntax acceptance, execution-only acceptance, difficulty-balanced execution filtering, and a mixed policy at matched row count and matched unique-question support. Report both retained questions and retained responses.
  • Verifier audit: sample syntax-accepted rows, execute them in the source test environment, stratify false accepts by source/difficulty, and preserve failing code and rejection reasons instead of publishing only survivors.
  • Scaling study: vary unique questions and responses per question independently; the paper's 25k-to-736k curve changes both coverage and volume.
  • Release checklist: publish question IDs, source revisions, generation seeds, all candidates, filter decisions, contamination neighbors/judgments, per-row execution labels, and license manifests.

Reuse class: conditionally suitable for SFT/distillation after version, rights, and correctness checks; strong as a construction/filtering audit reference; unsuitable as a clean evaluation benchmark because its questions and responses are training material. The current OCR-2 recipe can bootstrap implementation, but an OCR-1 replication must restore the paper's 16k generation contract rather than silently using 32 seeds and 28,768 tokens.

对 Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track 而言，该工作是可复用的设计与审计案例，而不只是模型分数报告。

  • 有条件的训练复用：固定 HF revision，保留全部 provenance 字段，解决逐来源许可，确定性重建 split_1 prompt，并在 SFT 前运行功能测试与针对目标 benchmark 的去污染。仅有发布层 CC BY 4.0 标签并不充分。
  • 筛选 baseline：在行数和唯一问题支持集匹配的条件下，比较格式/语法接收、只按执行接收、难度平衡的执行过滤和混合策略；同时报告保留问题数与保留响应数。
  • Verifier 审计：抽样语法合格行，在来源测试环境中执行，按来源/难度统计假接收，并保存失败代码和拒绝原因，而不是只发布幸存样本。
  • 扩展研究：独立改变唯一问题数与每题响应数；论文从 25k 到 736k 的曲线同时改变了覆盖面和体量。
  • 发布清单：公开问题 ID、来源 revision、生成种子、全部候选、筛选决策、污染邻居与判断、逐行执行标签和许可 manifest。

复用等级：在完成版本、权利和正确性检查后，可有条件用于 SFT/蒸馏；适合作为构造与筛选审计参考；由于问题和响应属于训练材料，不适合作为干净评测 benchmark。当前 OCR-2 配方可用于启动实现，但复现 OCR-1 时必须恢复论文的 16k 生成契约，而不能无说明地使用 32 个种子和 28,768 个 token。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 2 and Table 1 first: the paper corpus is 736,712 rows over 28,904 questions, not the HF 1.0 card's 735,255 rows over 28,319 questions.
  • Treat reasoning-tag, code-block, and Tree-sitter checks as format/syntax filters; they are not release-wide functional verification.
  • Read Section 4.1 and Table 3 together: the execution-filtering result is entangled with difficulty, question coverage, and the 445,618-versus-151,251 row comparison.
  • Use Table 2 with its caption: OCR results average repeated generations, while baseline rows were run once.
  • Pin code and data separately; the current 74b8649 recipe targets OCR-2 and differs from the OCR-1 paper in question pool and generation budget.

• 先读第 2 节与表 1：论文语料是 736,712 行、覆盖 28,904 个问题，不是 HF 1.0 卡片的 735,255 行与 28,319 个问题。
  • 把 reasoning-tag、code-block 和 Tree-sitter 检查看作格式/语法过滤；它们不是覆盖整个发布集的功能验证。
  • 结合阅读第 4.1 节与表 3：执行过滤结果与难度、问题覆盖及 445,618 对 151,251 的行数比较纠缠在一起。
  • 阅读表 2 时必须连同 caption：OCR 结果基于重复生成取平均，而 baseline 行只运行一次。
  • 分别固定代码与数据；当前 74b8649 配方面向 OCR-2，在问题池和生成预算上不同于 OCR-1 论文。

items: Syntax-valid code may be semantically wrong; release rows do not include release-wide unit-test outcomes.
The execution-filtering ablation confounds correctness with problem difficulty and instruction coverage; it does not establish that incorrect targets are generally beneficial.
Exact-match deduplication can retain semantic duplicates across overlapping public sources.
The contamination audit does not release nearest-neighbor, judge-output, or manual-decision manifests.
The paper reports 736,712 samples and 28,904 questions, while the HF 1.0 card reports 735,255 and 28,319; reuse requires a pinned revision.
The current official recipe is OCR-2-oriented and uses 32 random seeds and 28,768 generated tokens, so it is not a frozen OCR-1 reproduction manifest.
Release-level CC BY 4.0 does not eliminate per-source and platform license review.
OCR results are averaged over repeated runs while Table 2 says baselines were run once, leaving asymmetric uncertainty.
语法有效的代码可能语义错误；发布行不包括全发布范围的单元测试结果。
执行过滤消融将正确性与问题难度及指令覆盖混淆；它不确立不正确目标通常有益。
精确匹配去重可能在重叠公开来源间保留语义重复。
污染审计未发布最近邻、评审输出或人工判定清单。
论文报告 736,712 条样本与 28,904 题，而 HF 1.0 卡片报告 735,255 与 28,319；复用需要钉扎修订。
当前官方配方面向 OCR-2，并使用 32 个随机 seeds 与 28,768 个生成 tokens，因此不是冻结的 OCR-1 复现清单。
发布级 CC BY 4.0 并不免除按来源与平台的许可审查。
OCR 结果在重复运行上取平均，而 Table 2 称基线只运行一次，留下不对称不确定性。
